name: Grand Mercure Dalat
short_description: A 131-room French colonial-style resort across 12 villas near Da Lat's historic railway station, opened July 2026 in Vietnam's Central Highlands.
ai_summary: Grand Mercure Dalat opened on July 17, 2026 as a 131-room, 5-star resort spread across 12 French colonial-style villas near Da Lat's historic railway station and former French Quarter, in the Central Highlands city that already draws visitors for its cooler climate and colonial-era architecture. Rooms range from Superior categories to a Presidential Suite, set among rose gardens and pine forest, with dining spread across the all-day Deux Amants restaurant, BAO Asian cuisine, 1929 Lobby Bar, Moon Lounge, and Fleurie Café, plus a heated outdoor pool and La Maison Wellness Spa. As a property open only about a month at the time of research, independent guest reviews specific to this hotel had not yet accumulated in meaningful volume, so this profile leans on official Accor and press-preview sources rather than an established guest-sentiment track record.

core_facts.address: 03 Nguyen Du Street, Lam Vien - Da Lat Ward, Lam Dong Province, Vietnam
core_facts.neighborhood: Near Da Lat Railway Station / former French Quarter
elite_benefits: Complimentary breakfast or lounge access for ALL Diamond members at participating hotels, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless program terms
Room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 131 rooms and suites across 12 French colonial-style villas, a distinctive format for the Da Lat market
Walkable to Da Lat's historic railway station (about 900m) and former French Quarter
Rose gardens, pine forest setting, and a heated outdoor pool with mountain views
Five dining and drink venues, including farm-to-table Deux Amants and the 1929 Lobby Bar
One of very few internationally branded 5-star resorts in Da Lat itself
cons: Opened only in July 2026, so there is little independent guest-review history to verify service consistency
Set back from Xuan Huong Lake (about a 20-minute downhill walk), so central sightseeing requires a short trip
research_highlights: 131-room, 12-villa French colonial-style resort opened July 17, 2026 near Da Lat's historic train station
Design leans heavily into Da Lat's French colonial heritage -- Impressionist-inspired palettes, classical villa architecture, rose gardens
Positioned for weddings and events, with venues holding up to 200 guests
research_watchouts: Too new at time of research for meaningful independent guest-review volume -- treat guest-experience claims as provisional
Distinct from the separately operated, longer-running Mercure Dalat Resort elsewhere in the city -- the two are easy to confuse in third-party listings

faqs.question: When did Grand Mercure Dalat open?
faqs.answer: Grand Mercure Dalat opened on July 17, 2026, as a 131-room, 5-star resort spread across 12 French colonial-style villas near Da Lat's historic railway station. It's a distinct, newly built property from the separately operated Mercure Dalat Resort elsewhere in the city, so travelers should confirm which one they're booking.

faqs.question: What is the room and villa layout at Grand Mercure Dalat?
faqs.answer: The resort has 131 rooms and suites, including a Presidential Suite, distributed across 12 French colonial-style villa buildings arranged around gardens and courtyards rather than a single tower. Design draws on Da Lat's 1920s French heritage, with classic wood furnishings and Impressionist-inspired color palettes throughout.
